title: coworker_took_my_parkour_route
display_title: My coworker copied my parkour run frame-for-frame and claimed it was his idea
beats: My coworker (31M) posted my exact parkour route, same jumps, same blocks, one day after I showed it to him privately (29F).
No credit, no tag, just 40k views and comments calling him a genius.
I messaged him asking for a mention. He said 'ideas can't be owned, it's just Minecraft.'
So I posted my original recording with timestamps proving mine came first. His views tanked, mine exploded, and now our whole office Discord is picking sides.
He's telling people I'm sabotaging his 'content career.' So, Reddit... AITAH?
